description: Free AI tool that documents any business process or workflow. Describe your process in plain English and receive an execution-ready procedure with: structured sections, numbered steps, role assignments (who does what), deadline guidance, task type classification, and a separate Tallyfy automation section explaining how to make the process self-running. Output is a downloadable Word document with a marketing preamble and a back-page CTA to sign up at tallyfy.com/start for free, upload the document, and convert it into a live trackable workflow. No sign-up or account required to use this tool. Perfect for documenting SOPs, hiring workflows, customer onboarding, vendor approval chains, expense procedures, incident response runbooks, and any other repeatable business process. Built by Tallyfy, a workflow automation platform for teams.
